messages:
alex: Heads up — trying to land PR #23876 before the DB freeze (Wed 2025-02-12 02:00 UTC). CI looks mostly green but macos-e2e is flaky. Can we do a staggered merge + small canary and avoid touching prod traffic during the freeze? Need rebase window + approvals. Who can eyeball and approve?
riley: I can review and give a +1 if the tests are stable. What's failing on macos-e2e?
alex: The macos job times out intermittently on integration test `auth-session` — reproduced 2/6 runs. Snippet: `TimeoutError: request timed out after 120s` — appears to be a teardown hang. Not related to DB changes but still risky to merge during the freeze.
ci-bot: CI summary for PR #23876 — macos-e2e: 4/6 passed (latest run ID 987654321). Merge gating rules: require 2 consecutive green macos-e2e runs for merge. You can trigger `rerun-matrix` or target specific lanes.
jamie: Release note: DB freeze starts Wed 02:00 UTC. Rebase window closes Tue 22:30 UTC (we block merges after that). Staggered canary is fine — prefer 5% traffic and a manual rollback hook. I can monitor the canary. Plan suggestion: rebase tonight, get 2 consecutive greens, run staging canary with 5% traffic and a 30m watch, then promote before 22:30. If macos keeps flaking, do NOT merge into main during the freeze window.
alex: Goal is to land before 22:30 Tue. I'll rebase now and kick off reruns (US evening). Asking for a fast +1 from riley and canary readiness from jamie.
riley: +1 on the code. Queueing reruns now and I'll watch the macos lane — will flip to you with logs if it keeps failing. :eyes:
jamie: I'll prepare a canary manifest and set an automatic rollback at +10% failure rate. If we don't get steady CI by 22:00 UTC, we'll defer merge to the next maintenance window. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks all — starting reruns. Will post run IDs and results here. If we don't reach two consecutive greens by 22:00 I'll mark this as deferred and open a follow-up.
